propositions: models_at_or_above substring-matches Anthropic ladder names against the primary model, so a non-Anthropic primary matches nothing and falls through to return the whole ladder.
Escalation for an unlocated primary assigns claude-haiku-4-5 first, downgrading to a smaller window and switching provider family away from the operator's configured model.
largest_window_tokens returns the ladder maximum (1000000) for an unlocated model, overstating the window and causing P8 to under-block and truncate instead of asking the author to decompose.
The prerequisite-coverage escalation takes ladder[0] for an unlocated primary and has the same downgrade/family-jump defect via prerequisites.py.
Fix returns [model] for a truthy-but-unlocated primary to preserve the single-criterion retry while stopping before any cross-family rung.
Fix returns the ladder minimum window for an unlocated model since under-blocking is silent and over-blocking is loud and actionable.
